item.title: So, We Moved In
item.description: After years of building, many Bunnings trips and an unreasonable amount of sanding, we finally moved into the Miette in February. It is now October. So, what have we been doing for the last eight months? Well, apparently the building never really stops. First two minute noodles in the tiny house Close up to our noodles Table Of Contents Making the Tiny Actually Liveable Electricity Cosmetics Greywater A Few Learnings: The Tiny House Is Tiny Off on Another Adventure Making the Tiny Actually Liveable In February, we’ve bundled all of Erny’s gear inside, but with not much storage so everything was pretty much everywhere.

item.title: 2025 Aug to Oct Build Update
item.description: Let’s set the scene - it’s a sweltering 39 degrees in Spring (in celsius of course), the kind of heat that makes the air shimmer and the tools too hot to touch. The pollen is out in full force (it’s 100% worse this year), and the skylights are working overtime to pull in whatever breeze they can muster…and you’re oiling a kitchen bench top. Table Of Contents Shower Doors Kitchens Wedding Season Essentially, we’re on the final home straight - but my goodness it’s the longest home straight we’ve been on!
